name: zzBJ1_stance_ground

tests.name: there is a fixed datum to measure every skin against

detail.note: the Dog's own origin, held constant by G02. Relative to it is what the founder's 'copy Relay OG's ground contact' actually means.

tests.name: Relay OG was put back on the Dog, and it went back
every skin that IS a costume produced one whose bounds could be read

detail.note: Relay OG is the canon body rather than a costume, so four of five is the expected count and the first run's red was this job's assumption, not a defect.

tests.name: the Dog stood still for the whole run, so the skins are compared in one place

detail.note: THE CONTROL. A Dog that wandered between skins turns a ground-contact comparison into a comparison of two different bits of floor.

tests.name: every costume's lowest geometry sits at the same height

detail.note: REPORTED, NOT TRUSTED AS FEET. An actor's bounds include its EFFECTS: Arden Infernal reads 348.9 uu tall against 199.2 for Celestial Light and its bounds bottom sits 50 uu lower, which is its flame plume rather than its feet. So a red here is a statement about total extent, and the founder's 'ground contact' needs the foot COMPONENTS rather than the actor's bounds. Height is reported alongside so size is not mistaken for stance.

tests.name: every costume is rooted on the Dog by the SAME offset, with none set apart

detail.note: a uniform offset is the rig; a DIFFERING one would be the per-skin cosmetic offset the founder asked not to be used as a fix. Measured at [0, 0, -87.07] for all four in the first run, which is evidence AGAINST a per-skin root-pose cause.

reference_is: the lowest costume, since Relay OG has no costume actor
